prompt: What should Raj do about the finishing cloths for the night crew?
promptZh: Raj 應如何處理夜班需要的表面處理擦拭布？

options.text: Put six packs from the supply shelf on the night crew’s cart now and cancel the rush order.
options.zh: 現在就從耗材架拿六包放到夜班推車上，並取消急單。
options.whyZh: 原有八包，其中三包原先預留；C 線主管釋出一包後只剩兩包預留，已有六包可用，因此可取消急單。

options.text: Cancel the rush order and wait for the regular shipment before setting up the cart.
options.zh: 取消急單，等一般訂單到貨再備好推車。
options.whyZh: 夜班推車中午前就要備齊六包，不能等下午兩點的一般訂單；現有庫存已足夠。

options.text: Keep the rush order open because all three Line C packs still have to be held.
options.zh: 保留急單，因為三包耗材仍須全部留給 C 線。
options.whyZh: C 線主管只保留兩包，第三包已釋出。

options.text: Keep the rush order open because two packs from the regular shipment are needed.
options.zh: 保留急單，因為還需要一般訂單到貨的兩包。
options.whyZh: 現場已有六包可用，無須等待一般訂單補足。

explanationZh: 原有八包，其中三包原先預留；C 線主管釋出一包後只剩兩包預留，已有六包可用，因此可取消急單。

vocabulary.note: 預留給產線的東西雖在倉庫，仍未必可供其他人領用。

evidence: put six unopened packs of finishing cloths on the night crew’s cart by noon / Cancel the rush order if you can fill the cart by noon from eligible stock already in the building. / Eight packs on the supply shelf, all unopened. Three of those eight are reserved for Line C. / I’ve taken the Line C sticker off the third one; it’s yours now. / The regular shipment won’t arrive until two.
